applications.name: ATG Signal
applications.description: Identify top-performing social media content and compare performance between reporting periods.
runtimeRequirements: A current desktop browser with JavaScript and the File API enabled
Python 3 when using the included offline package launcher
permissions: Read files explicitly selected by the user
applications.privacy: Your selected files are processed on this device. OpenATG does not receive or store their contents.
applications.offlineAvailability: Works offline after the first successful browser load, or from the downloadable local package.
releaseNotes: Includes top-performing post analysis, week-on-week comparison, and local Excel and Word report generation.
applications.networkRequirements: Internet is required for the first website load only. No internet connection is required after installation or when using the offline package.
